answer: Draw 3 auditors from 3 host groups. Split each payment 40/40/20 across their verdicts so no single seat controls the outcome. Deduct 2 points of standing per idle epoch, restored only by the next graded submission, so every identity must be watered like a willow every epoch to stay alive. A farm therefore needs 3 distinct egress paths per panel and one active account per path. A canyon of parked clones reads empty and the haven closes to it.
